text:
inc-bot: ALERT: GPU pool us-west-2 inference-gpu-1 experiencing sustained queue growth and 5xx/429 spike. queue_length: 1240 (baseline 120), p95_latency: 820ms, 429_rate: 18% -> paging oncall

ashok: paging in - I'm oncall. saw the alert, jumping in. what's the customer impact?

adele: multiple customer reports about slow responses and 429s. Support triage: ~12 customers seeing degraded throughput; 3 customers (enterprise tiers) reported production outages.

maria: I'm with ashok. last deploy? any rate-limit config changes in last hour?

jon: I rolled out rate-limiter changes 14m ago (token-bucket refactor). TL;DR: mis-specified the scope -> bucket was applied at pool-level instead of per-node. That would cause aggressive global throttling under saturation.

ashok: copy. looks like autoscaler also tried to spin up more gpus but failed repeatedly. logs: 
```
2026-03-14T14:02:17Z autoscaler: RequestScale(vgpu_pool=us-west-2:inference-gpu-1, delta=+4) -> failed: QuotaExceeded: vGPU quota 0/8 available for project-redwood-prod
2026-03-14T14:02:22Z autoscaler: Retry scale -> failed: Insufficient capacity in AZ us-west-2b
2026-03-14T14:05:30Z autoscaler: Requeue scale, backoff 30s
```

ashok: so two pain points: 1) rate-limiter misconfig applying global token bucket 2) autoscaler can't allocate due to provider quota/capacity. both cause queue to grow and 429s.

adele: customers want ETA. any mitigations we can do short-term?

jon: immediate mitigations I can try: 
- rollback token-bucket config (revert PR) -> remove pool-level bucket, restore per-node buckets
- temporarily increase burst size on affected buckets to allow drain
- fallback routing: route enterprise traffic to reserved Dedicated pool if capacity exists (but we need to check Dedicated free slots)

maria: i'll coordinate with infra to check Dedicated and provider quotas. ashok, can you take lead on traffic mitigation and coordination with support?

ashok: on it. Maria - pinging infra: @jon is doing rollback if we give the thumbs.

jon: deploy-bot please initiate rollback of rate-limiter config (PR #4821 revert).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling back config change: PR #4821-revert -> starting canary rollback to config-store.

adele: notifying top-affected customers with a short note: "We're aware of increased 429s and are performing immediate mitigation. We'll update within 15 min."

jon: technical note: the misconfig change turned this: 
```
rate_limit_scope: per_node
bucket_size: 100
burst: 50
```
into this by accident: 
```
rate_limit_scope: pool
bucket_size: 100
burst: 50
```
Pool-level buckets mean all requests share a single token bucket; under saturation that causes global 429s even if some nodes are idle.

ashok: rollback in progress?

deploy-bot: rollback to config v2026-03-14_13:47 complete on config-store; propagation to edge proxies started.

maria: while rollback propagates, we should also loosen the token bucket parameters to help drain backlog. Jon, can you bump burst to 500 temporarily for the per-node buckets?

jon: bumping burst via config API: 
```
curl -X POST https://config.internal/api/v1/buckets/update \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"scope":"per_node","burst":500}'
```
applied. confirmed on 6/6 nodes in us-west-2.

ashok: autoscaler still failing due to provider quota. Maria - what's the status on quota/capacity?

maria: provider ticket opened (INC-8142) with cloud team for vGPU quota bump. provider replied: quota request received, human review required -> ETA unknown (30-120m). I'm checking Dedicated pool availability now.

jon: if Dedicated has idle slots we can route enterprise customers there. I see 2 idle g4dn nodes in dedicated-east but cross-region would add latency. There's 1 idle in dedicated-us-west but it's in maintenance window.

ashok: we should also enable degraded-mode routing: accept requests but route them to slower/quantized model variant (gpt-small-quant) to reduce GPU memory and increase throughput. Adele coordinate messaging: we'll label as degraded fallback and ask customers to opt-in?

adele: messaging drafted: "We're routing traffic to a lower-latency fallback model to reduce throttling. Expect lower quality but improved availability. More updates within 30m." Sending now to affected customers.

jon: enabled fallback routing for enterprise_tier in us-west-2 -> service flag set: `fallback_gpt_small=true`

inc-bot: NOTE: 429 rate dropping: 18% -> 7% over last 6m. queue_length: 1240 -> 480. p95_latency: 820ms -> 420ms.

maria: good trend. continue monitoring. Ashok, can you take a handoff in 20m? I'll stay as bridge until provider response.

ashok: yep i'll take 20m. who will own postmortem? Maria/Eng-ML?

jon: I'll own the postmortem for the config change and rollout process gaps. Will include timeline, diff, and remediation items (improve staging tests, enforce per-node unit tests).

maria: I'll own capacity and autoscaler investigation; action items: (1) add autoscaler retry logic to detect provider quota vs infra capacity and fall back sooner; (2) document emergency Dedicated failover steps; (3) run a quota audit for critical regions.

adele: Support action items: customer postmortem template, proactive notifications, and follow-ups with customers flagged.

ashok: current severity: Sev2 (partial outage for some customers). We'll update severity after provider response.

jon: follow-up: PR process note - the token-bucket refactor should have had a staging rollout and integration test that verifies scope semantics. Adding that to remediation.

deploy-bot: config diff applied: reverted pool-scope change, burst temporarily increased.

inc-bot: RESOLVED/RECOVERING: 429s down to 2.3%, queue 120, p95 210ms. Incident moving to monitoring.

ashok: handing off to oncall-maria in 5m. nice job team. :thumbsup:

maria: handing oncall to ashok. I'll stay on bridge for 30m for follow-ups.

jon: creating postmortem draft: https://redwood-internal/pm/incidents/1769123456-draft

adele: customer comms sent. customers acknowledged.

ashok: closing out messages. Action items to track in JIRA: RINF-3421 (postmortem), RINF-3422 (autoscaler improvements), RINF-3423 (quota audit).

inc-bot: Thread closed for active paging. Record: Mitigations: rollback rate-limit config, increase burst, enable fallback model routing, open provider quota ticket, route enterprise where possible.
